paite: Huan Solomon in Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh toh kizolhna abawl hi. Pharaoh tanu akitenpih a, ama inn ding leh TOUPA' inn ding alam khit ma leh Jerusalem kulh a-umsuak masiah David khopi ah a omsak hi.
heading: Pilna Ngen In Solomon Athum / (2 Kro 1.3-12)
english: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her into David’s city until he had finished building his own house, Yahweh’s house, and the wall around Jerusalem.

paite: Mipite kia mun sangte ah akithoih ua, huai ma in TOUPA min a dia inn akilam nai takdih louh ziak in.
english: However, the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was not yet a house built for Yahweh’s name.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA a-it a, apa David dan thusehte azui a; mun sangte a kithoih in, gimlimte kia ana hal hi.
english: Solomon loved Yahweh, walking in the statutes of David his father, except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

paite: Kithoih ding in Gibeon ah kumpipa ahoh hi; huai lah mun sang poimohtak ahi ngal a. Solomon in huai maitam tung ah halmang thillat sangkhat alan hi.
english: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

paite: Gibeon ah zan in Solomon kiang ah amang in TOUPA ahong kihil hi. Pathian in akiang ah, "Ngen in, bang ahia ka hon piak ding?" achi hi.
english: In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”

paite: Solomon in, "Na sikha, ka pa David na mitmuh a thutak leh diktatna leh lungtang diktak pu a a-om bang in, nang akiang ah hehpihna thupi mahmah na langsak hi. Nang hiai hehpihna thupi mahmah ama a ding in na guan a, nang alaltutphah a tu ding tapa na pia a, tuni a ahong om petmah bang in.
english: Solomon said, “You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness, because he walked before you in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you. You have kept for him this great loving kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is today.

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, nang na sikha, ka pa David sik in kumpipa in na hon bawlta hi. Kei zaw naupang leltak ka hi a; thu tung lam leh pawt lam leng ka thei kei hi.
english: Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.

paite: Na sikha, na mitelte, mi tampi, atam ziak ua sim seng vual louh leh azah theihseng vuallouhte lak ah a-om hi.
english: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.

paite: Huaiziak in na mite vai hawmsak ding in na sikha theihsiamna lungtang pia in, huchi a asia leh apha ka khenkak theihna ding in. Na mi hiai zah zouzai kua'n ahia vai hawmsak thei ding?" achi hi.
english: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”

paite: Solomon in huai ngen a, athugen in TOUPA akipaksak hi.
english: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

paite: Pathian in akiang ah, "Na damsawtna ding, nang a dia hauhsaknate, na melmate sihna ding ngen lou a, vaihawm siamna dia theihsiamna na nget zawk ziak in;
english: God said to him, “Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life, nor have you asked for riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice,

paite: ngai in, na nget bang in ka hihta hi. Ngai in, pilna leh theihsiamna lungtang ka hon pia hi. Huchi in na ma ah nang bang kuamah a-om kei ding ua, na nung in leng nang bang kuamah ahong om sam kei ding.
english: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.

paite: Na nget louh, hauhsakna leh zahtakhuaina leng ka hon pe lai hi. Huchi in na damsung in kumpipate lak ah nang bang a-om kei ding uh.
english: I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you for all your days.

paite: Na pa David in azuih bang a ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte zui dia ka lampite a na paileh ka hon damsawtsak lai ding hi,” achi hi.
english: If you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days.”

paite: Solomon akhanglou lou a, ngai in, mang ana hi. Huchi in Jerusalem ah ahoh a, TOUPA thukhun bawm ma ah adingh a, halmang thillat leh lemna thillatte alan a, asikhate tengteng a ding in ankuang alui hi.
english: Solomon awoke; and behold, it was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and offered up burnt offerings, offered peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.

paite: Kizuak numei nih kumpipa kiang ah ahong ua, ama ah ava dingh uhi.
heading: Solomon In Thubuai Haksa Akhen
english: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king, and stood before him.

paite: Numei khat in, "Aw ka toupa, hiai numei toh inn khat a tengkhawm ka hi ua; huai inn a amah toh ka om lai un nau ka nei hi.
english: The one woman said, “Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house. I delivered a child with her in the house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ka nau neih nung ani thum ni in hiai numei in leng nau anei sam hi. Omkhawm ka hi ua; huai inn a om koute gel lou, kuamah mikhual om a-om kei hi.
english: The third day after I delivered, this woman delivered also. We were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, just us two in the house.

paite: Zan in hiai numei ta ana si a; ama'n adelhlup khak ahi.
english: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.

paite: Zan lai in athou a, na sikhanu a-ihmut kal in, ka sik a ka tapa ana la a, apom a, ama ta si pen ka ang ah ana sial hi.
english: She arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me while your servant slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

paite: Zingsang a ka ta nawi pe dia ka thohleh, ngai in, ana si khin hi. Himahleh zingsang a ka etchetleh ngai in, ka suan ka tapa pen ana hi kei," achi hi.
english: When I rose in the morning to nurse my child, behold, he was dead; but when I had looked at him in the morning, behold, it was not my son whom I bore.”

paite: Numei dang in, "Hilou e. Ahing pen kei tapa ahi a, asi pen nang tapa ahi," achi hi. Khat in, "Hilou, asi pen na tapa ahi a, ahing pen ka tapa ahi,” achi tinten hi. Huchibang in kumpipa ma ah agen tuaktuak uhi.
english: The other woman said, “No! But the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son.” The first one said, “No! But the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son.” They argued like this before the king.

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Khat in, ahing pen ka tapa ahi a, asi pen na tapa ahi,” achi hi. Khat pen in, "Hilou, asi pen na tapa ahi, ahing pen ka tapa ahi zaw, achi zel hi," achi hi.
english: Then the king said, “One says, ‘This is my son who lives, and your son is the dead one;’ and the other says, ‘No! But your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Namsau hon va lak un," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa ma ah namsau ahon tawi uhi.
english: The king said, “Get me a sword.” So they brought a sword before the king.

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Naungek hing pen tum nih suah unla, akimkhat khat pia unla, adang khat kiang ah akimkhat pia un," achi hi.
english: The king said, “Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.”

paite: Naungek hing pen nu in ata alainat mahmah ziak in kumpipa kiang ah, "Aw ka toupa, naungek hing pen amah pe mai in, that mahmah ke'n," achita hi. Khat pen in, "Kei a hi tuan dah henla, nang a leng lah hi tuan kei heh. Himahleh tumtan hi hen," achita hi.
english: Then the woman whose the living child was spoke to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, “Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no way kill him!” But the other said, “He shall be neither mine nor yours. Divide him.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n adawng a, "Naungek hing pen that kei unla, amah pia un. Amah anu ahi,” achi hi.
english: Then the king answered, “Give the first woman the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”

paite: Israel tengteng in huai thu a kumpipa thukhendan ana za ua; kumpipa alau uh. Vaihawm ding in Pathian pilna amah ah a-om chih athei uhi.
english: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to do justice.
